author: reek
body: Setting/landscape designer, fully DB-backed. The page ships no content: at load it fetches each dimension's rows from the bare-metal DB server over AJAX (/api/d/<table>) and builds the pip tree from the fetched rows. Each row is [name, prompt-fragment]; selections index into the parsed rows (tbl-field) for both the visible name and the prompt fragment. The fetch helpers (parse-table / tbl-names / tbl-field) live in ExplorerTheme.
